This paper explores the realization of lean maintenance by putting forward updating maintenance concept, stressing on academic innovation and integration, attaching importance to application and popularizing lean maintenance theory and enhancing the culture construction of lean maintenance theory, which provide powerful technique supporting and theoretical basis for the equipment maintenance reform.

articleTitle: A Physical Model based research for fault diagnosis of gear crack
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Because of the advantage of gear, gearbox was used widely. But its fault also brought many losses of the production and society. It was necessary to research and analysis on the dynamical behavior of the gear system. One kind of gear fault was numerically simulated so that the influence of gear fault to change of vibration state was studied theoretically, and the symptom generated by faults was found. A finite element model with crack in gear roots was established with mixed meshing of singularity and isoparametric elements. The automatic analysis program of crack propagation was developed based on the ABAQUS software and linear elasticity fracture mechanics. The crack propagation of involutes' gear was simulated. The structural experiments of fault crack with different types and sizes were done, the vibration signals of the fault gear body and system were tested, and the dynamical characteristics of the structure and system were gained. The results were compared to that of simulation and theory, the validity of the theoretic and simulative was testified and the reliability was proved. There was important guidance for predicting the residual life of the gear with crack.

articleTitle: A general energy-based model for fatigue life prediction of high-temperature structural materials
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Improved fatigue life prediction methods will assist in reducing life cycle costs and increasing the availability of mechanical components. These methods include Stromeyer function, Basquin law, Manson-Coffin law, frequency modified damage function (FMDF) model, strain range partition (SRP) and so on. However, different models are applied to assess the life under high cycle fatigue (HCF) and low cycle fatigue (LCF). This is a domain of concern in the development of fatigue life prediction models which contain combinations of HCF and LCF. In this paper, based on the Manson-Coffin law and an energy-based damage parameter, a general energy-based model is presented to predict fatigue life under both HCF and LCF conditions. By correlated with the energy-based damage parameter to the test data of superalloys GH901 and K403 in existing literatures, the lives predicted by the proposed model are compared with experimental results resulting in a good agreement.

articleTitle: Study on dynamic reliability simulation analyzing method of thermodynamic process
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Traditional dynamic reliability analyzing methods which are evolved from those methods used in discrete system, are short in dealing with continuous variable and process variable. Using dynamic reliability analyzing methods, this paper proposes a system hybrid dynamic model in which discrete events are included in the continuous system model. Simulation results show that this method can detailed depict perplexing thermodynamic process, and the influence of system process and random variables to the thermodynamic process dynamic reliability can be accurately reflected.

articleTitle: Equipment spare parts demand forecasting model based on grey neural network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Equipment spare parts demand forecasting is the precondition of conducting effective spare parts supporting. Equipment spare parts demand change is the result of comprehensive factors and single model forecasting accuracy is not high. Aim to improve the precision of equipment spare parts demand forecasting, a forecasting method of equipment spare parts demand is proposed using grey neural network based on analyzing the main factors influencing spare parts wastage synthetically. The proposed method uses the grey forecasting model to train the training samples and gets the BP neural network input value, then BP neural network is used to get the equipment spare parts demand results. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method has higher forecasting precision compared with single forecasting model, which verifies the correctness and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design and comparison of flight-control-system redundancy
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: The increased amount of redundant units means improvement of task reliability, however, the additional units and corresponding vote devices request more logistics, which results in decline of basic reliability. In this paper, we design and make analysis and comparison of multiple redundant structures in two ways of task reliability and basic reliability. This paper provides theoretical reference for FCS redundancy design.

articleTitle: Reliability assessment of a truck engine based on measurements of combustion chamber tightness
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: The article shows an analysis of the reliability of a compression-ignition engine used in a medium duty truck. The criterion for the reliability assessment was the decrease in combustion chamber tightness. The analysis was based on the results of compression pressure tests and leak-down tests conducted during a long-term operation of 5 trucks. Experimental survival functions and then continuous reliability functions, fitted to the empirical ones, were determined along with the failure rate functions.

articleTitle: Explores of maintenance system based on cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: The traditional detection of equipment maintenance costs too many resources, but it can not meet the needs of modern maintenance. The application of cloud computing in maintenance can make the maintenance much more efficiency. In this paper, application of cloud computing is discussed in maintenance.

articleTitle: Analysis of joint capabilities integration and development system of U.S. ARMY
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Joint Capabilities Integration and Development System is the system for U.S. Army to define potential operational capability gaps or technical opportunities, i.e., the system for demonstration of operational capability requirements. With view to regulate the operational capability requirements demonstration and enhance the standard and quality of demonstration, U.S. Army has issued 6 editions of Joint Capabilities Integration and Development System Guide and implemented a series of detailed regulations since June 24, 2003,. This paper has analyzed the major advantage, analysis method, analysis process and apocalypses of Joint Capabilities Integration and Development system, aiming at giving references to military equipments requirements demonstration in PRC.

articleTitle: The design of Safety Management Information System of Work Safety Standardization
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Work Safety Standardization of enterprise is a detailed and tedious work, because the level of the safety management and information for the majority of our enterprise is not high, slow progress in the safety standardization. Safety Management Information System of Work Safety Standardization will make the work network and systematic, greatly enhance the security management level. The paper combines of “The basic norms for Work Safety Standardization of enterprises”, as the support of the computer information technology, designs of system architecture of Safety Management Information System of Work Safety Standardization, providing network-based, standardized security management platform.

articleTitle: Product design optimization with simulation-based reliability analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Evaluating probabilistic constraints plays a very important role in the reliability-based design optimization (RBDO). Traditional Monte Carlo simulation-based approach can provide a high accuracy but with low efficiency. In this paper, a subset simulation-based reliability analysis approach is provided to address the efficiency problem. The method is also compared with the typical MPP-based method.

articleTitle: Reliability and maintainability analysis and design on a type of gun fire control system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Based on the principles of reliability and maintainability, a type of gun fire control system was taken as research object. The method combining the system composition character with the system reliability index allocation model was used to realize the technique of system reliability. The system failure rate and fault distribution principle were combined with maintainability realization principle to discuss the technology implementation of system maintainability.

articleTitle: On food safety system construction from the perspective of supply chain
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Food safety has been a hot topic of global focus. In this paper, we concentrate on food safety from the perspective of supply chain. To do this, we develop a mechanism combining government, industries and society together, and we show that such a structure provides an available approach to improving food safety in China.

articleTitle: Design and development of the newest armored equipments weapon maintenance training simulation system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: According to the current circumstances, the cultivating and training of the newest armored equipments maintenance support personnel is difficult to meet army's demand all the time, and can't meet the needs of equipments development either, we researched the maintenance training simulation system which is basic to half-practicality and virtual reality technology in chief. We made the overall design of the armored equipments weapon, which is aimed at the weapen system, and developed the half-practicality maintenance training subsystem according to the reform of simulator, and the virtual maintenance training subsystem and teachinging board to show the control principles, what these thing we do is very important to open up means of maintenance training and improve the level of maintenance support personnel, and provide maintenance training experience for the others weapon equipments.

articleTitle: A method of constructing comprehensive reliability testing profile based on hardware and software
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Test data generation relies on the profile during the reliability testing. However, software and hardware reliability test profile are considered separately in imbedded system, and it is not a true indication of the usage to the system. In this paper, we shall first contrast of the test profile construction flow of hardware and software, and find out the integrating of them. And then advance the method of construct comprehensive reliability testing profile based on hardware/software combination, which on the basis of improved software reliability test profile. Finally, by the factual for an Aeroengine Digital Control System, the rationality, effectiveness and feasibility of this method is proved. Furthermore, it supports the research of the embedded system reliability validation and evaluation.

articleTitle: The applicability of traditional sampling techniques in the measurement of LAN availability
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: The net flow is increased gradually with the rapid development of Internet, therefore it is impossible and unaffordable to capture and analysis every packet in network measure. Many scholars have developed variety of packet sampling techniques. However, the parameters researched were not about network availability, and the difference among applications was not considered. In this paper, the conception of network availability based on different applications was explained. The influence of using different traditional sampling techniques, including simple random sampling, periodic sampling and systematic sampling, were discussed by experiments based on three typical protocols in LAN. Finally, the applicable network sampling techniques for availability based on different protocols were recommended.

articleTitle: Determination of degradation change point using spline function
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: A degradation process is usually non-linear, and hence there exists one or more change points, where the degradation rate changes quickly. It is useful to determine the change points, e.g., designing an inspection scheme and predicting the time to a functional failure. It is an important issue how to specify the change points. This paper addresses this issue. A spline function with unknown knots is used to fit the observed degradation data and the estimated knots are the estimates of degradation change points. The information criterion is used to determine the optimal degree of spline function. The potential applications of the results are discussed, and the usefulness and appropriateness are illustrated by a real-world example.

articleTitle: Health condition-based maintenance decision intelligent reasoning method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: A method integrates case-based reasoning (CBR) with rule-based reasoning (RBR) is developed in this paper. Based on these two artificial intelligence techniques, it is used in the design of maintenance decision system. According to the characteristics and requirements of equipments' health condition, the structure and workflow of health condition-based maintenance decision intelligent reasoning method is proposed, then a system was explored and deliberated.

articleTitle: Study on current development and strategies of equipment software support
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of Software-Intensive System (SIS), equipment software system plays more important role in new-generation weapon. The current development of equipment software is summarized. In order to improve the safeguard capacity of equipment software and form complete and comprehensive safeguard architecture, the key input and output factors of estimation model for equipment software is established. According to the standard of ISO/IEC 12207, the whole life cycle of equipment software is divided into three different processes and corresponding activities in three processes are defined in detail. Aiming to the blindness of equipment software's transplant and retirement, the activities in transplant and retirement processes are emphasized. Possible changes and the corresponding works in equipment software's whole life cycle are also defined. Finally, the means to enhance the level of equipment software support for such conceptual change, regulation and system and talents training are discussed.

articleTitle: Reliability modeling method for network system using generalized stochastic petri net
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: The traditional reliability modeling method is difficult to model and analyze the reliability for network system (NS), and a new reliability modeling method for NS based on generalized stochastic petri net(GSPN) is proposed. On the basis of discussing the formalization definition of GSPN and constructing the relation between the modeling elements of GSPN and the parameters of reliability model, it describes the process of modeling the reliability model for NS particularly. Finally, a certain type of integrated vetronics system (IVS) is selected as an example, and the proposed modeling method is validated.

articleTitle: Based on HHM of the coal mine safety risk assessment methods
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: This paper carries out coal mine safety risk identification from different ways and levels integrated with hierarchical holographic model (HHM), and realizes model construction through five aspects of coal mine disaster, personnel, equipment, environment and management. The paper proposes methods of risk filter and risk evaluation, accomplishes ranking of coal mine safety risk combining double standard ranking filter, and supplies strategic decisions of risk management for managers.

articleTitle: Analysis on comparison of Permutation Entropy with Correlation Dimension for abnormality detection of a rolling bearing
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Permutation entropy and fractal theory are new methods which are used to study irregularity and nonlinearity of a complex system in nature. Principle of Permutation Entropy (PE) and Correlation Dimension (CD) is introduced in this paper firstly, their differences in describing the complexity of vibration signal were analyzed and the selection methods of algorithm parameters were put forward, then taking the whole life vibration data of a bearing as an example, PE and CD algorithm were applied to detect abnormal characteristics respectively, and their difference on abnormal detection are compared with each other. It is concluded that the result of two detection methods is basically coincident, but PE has advantages in computational efficiency, which is much more suitable for online monitoring and will play an important role in preventive maintenance of mechanical equipments.

articleTitle: Ammunition storage reliability forecasting based on radial basis function neural network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: In order to forecast ammunition storage reliability better, the paper researched a forecasting method based on neural network which is with the ability of actualizing multi-nonlinear mapping from input to output, and discussed steps of forecasting based on radial basis function (RBF) network. The storage reliability of one new-style ammunition is forecasted based on RBF network. The results show that RBF is suitable for ammunition storage reliability forecasting, and the precision of the train goal is better by using RBF network than by using BP network. RBF network is more suitable for dealing with this problem.

articleTitle: The research of CBM+ strategies of the military equipment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: The CBM+ is based on the CBM, describes, with quantization which can be measured, the use of the equipment and breakdown features with the compositive and relevant technical methods and data analysis methods, is also the maintenance strategy of the USA and the Russia in the new military revolution. This paper discusses the way to realize the military equipment CBM+, based on analyzing the features of the CBM+, the basic frame and the main content of the maintenance strategies.

articleTitle: The quanlity mamagement issues emphasize in the equipment operational phase
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Satisfactory equipment quality is related to the each phase of equipment life cycle, and then the equipment quality problem of operational phase should be our focus. This paper describes equipment quality and quality management contents of the operational phase. And then the influence factors on equipment quality of the operational phase are analyzed. Finally, we put forward related significant issues of equipment quality management during operational phase.

articleTitle: A research on the model and simulation evaluation for operational availability
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: The paper analyzes the conception and the measuring model of operational availability. For the restrictions of present models' assumptions, an instantaneous operational availability model and an average operational availability model for evaluating material availability together with a simulation method for the two models are put forward. The distinctions between the two models are also given by the simulation example. The analyzing of sensitivity factors shows that material reliability is the key factor affecting the operational availability, and the most effective way to improve operational availability is to increase reliability.

articleTitle: Application of balanced score card in LCC management
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Minimizing LCC is an important way in cost control. But the system life cycle can be influenced by many factors, such as the change of strategic target and the application of new technology. In this case, how can LCC be optimized? In this paper, application of balanced score card is discussed in LCC optimization process on condition that the strategic target hasn't been changed.

articleTitle: Analysis of changes of mechanism workability and reliability
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Taking slider-crank mechanism for example, we analyze the wear process of mechanism workability and changes of mechanism reliability. Then we get the relationship between mechanism workability and reliability. Also we analyze the impact of spare parts' quality on the recovery of mechanism workability and the recovery level of workability. Finally, according to the change process of workability, we discuss the determination of maintenance cycle.

articleTitle: A novel trust model based on bayes statistics
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Based on Bayesian statistics, this paper presents a novel P2P trust model BTtrust. The history records of transaction and prior beliefs are used to derive the global trust value of every node. Every node trades with peers with high trust values. Mathematical analysis and simulation results show BTtrust can resist attacks of malicious peers and improve the successful download rate of the whole P2P system.

articleTitle: Fault simulation and abrasion failure life forecast of key components for breech mechanism based on virtual prototype
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Breech mechanism is the key and important device to improve reliability and maintenance for large caliber guns. It's major fault mode is grain abrasion caused by dry sliding friction. There are no feasible and practical technologies to simulate and predict the abrasion failure life of key components for breech mechanism. A new simulation and prediction method is firstly put forward in this paper. Based on Pro/E and ADAMS, the virtual prototype of breech mechanism of semiautomatic vertical sliding-wedge type is established. To validate its precision and affectivity, qualitative and quantitative verification methods are adopted to check the virtual prototype of breech mechanism. Virtual prototype produces key components' load spectrums and failure thresholds. Dry sliding friction and abrasion experiment provides abrasion rules of typical materials. Finial simulation and prediction results are given as abrasion thresholds and operating items, which provide sufficient references for breech mechanism's maintenance and safeguard.

articleTitle: The optimization model of sensors set based on hidden Markov model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: The design processes and methods of PHM system based on HMM have been investigated. HMM has some advantage in terms of dealing with small sample size and high discerning accuracy. The rationality of sensors set which is based on the hidden Markov model has been evaluated from quantitative point of view. Then the evaluating method of different sensor sets based on HMM has been put forward. At last, the effectiveness of process and method has been validated by using the data of gear case.

articleTitle: Study on issues of military equipment contractor maintenance support
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: With the development of the high-technology, the military equipments' system structure are becoming more and more complex, and the maintenance power of the military itself isn't enough. Today, using contractor to support the military equipment is the common practice of the most developed countries. The paper indicates the existing contradictory questions of equipment construction based on the practices of equipment support construction of our military in recent years, and researches the main issues of the regulations and mechanism system, task partition standards, risk control management, resource allotment and optimization and wartime safety and support for implementing the contractor maintenance support.

articleTitle: Research on maintenance task allocation and support resource requirement analysis for ordnance equipment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: New ordnance equipment posed a new challenge for maintenance support ability of the army. It is urgent to set up a scientific method to allocate maintenance task and layout support resource. Aimed at this requirement, a general method of maintenance task allocation and support resource programming is built up which can optimize and standardize the analysis process. The key techniques and their interfaces are studied. At last, a corresponding Computer-Aided Decision Analysis System (CADAS) is developed to improve the efficiency of maintenance task analysis and maintenance support resource requirement analysis, which has some practical value to enhance the support ability of the army.

articleTitle: Study on the application of interval analysis and probabilistic method in compressive bar's stable response
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Interval analysis and probabilistic method are investigated in this paper for compressive bar's stable responses with uncertain parameters. According to the set relationships and probability statistics theory, the relationship between above two methods can be analyzed by introducing Chebyshew inequality. Took compressive bar in certain equipment for example, analyzed it with interval analysis and probabilistic method, respectively, the results showed that interval analysis is more reliable than probabilistic method in the cases of less data and incomplete information.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis research on gun chassis engine based on the burning gas pressure
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Modern self-propelled artilleries compose weapons parts and chassis parts. Its chassis is walking part of self-propelled artilleries and the chassis engine is the heart of the walking part. Technical state of the engine directly influences the condition of artillery technology. Thus, the research on fault diagnosis of the chassis engine of artilleries is very important. Fault diagnosis of the engine of artillery chassis based on gas pressure are analyzed and researched in this paper.

articleTitle: Equipment quality information and its management during operation phase
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Quality information work is one of the basic work for total quality management of equipment. Quality information is important to the equipment operation phase and its management is an important foundation for realizing the state of equipment quality and improving the equipment quality. Starting with the analysis of the function and character of quality information in equipment operation phase, this paper paper researches the keystone and flow of the information gathering, and the establishment of equipment quality information organization is discussed. Finally, insights about managing node for controlling quality information and the main content of quality information in the equipment operation phase are presented.

articleTitle: Reliability-based design optimization for pressure shell of remotely operated vehicle with discrete and continuous variables
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Ring-stiffened cylinder is one of the most structure types in pressure shell of remotely operated vehicle (ROV). In pressure shell optimization design problem, both discrete and continuous variables are involved and uncertainties are ubiquitous in any stage of the ROV development. However, pressure shell of ROV presently designed via the static strength and the rounding method which might result in more redundancy than required. In this paper, reliability-based design optimization (RBDO) with mixed discrete and continuous random variables is proposed to handle the pressure shell design and first-order reliability method (FORM) is used to calculate reliability of the pressure shell performance functions. The effectiveness of the proposed method for pressure shell design is validated by an engineering example.

articleTitle: Optimization of step stress accelerated degradation test plans based on MSE
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: To reliability prediction of products with high reliability and long life, the Step Stress Accelerated Degradation Test (SSADT) is commonly applied. With the motivation of predicting product reliability most precisely, this paper discusses degradation process of products using Birnbaum-Saunders model, and proposes an optimal design method of SSADT. In order to minimize the mean square error (MSE) of product operation reliability, the test plans of SSADT under specified total test cost by utilizing Monte Carlo simulation. The plans can determine the optimal sample size, parameter measurement interval and measurement times of SSADT. In the end of this paper, we present an example of permanent magnet used in satellite to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on the maintenance personnel ability evaluation based on fuzzy evaluating method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: A new method is presented for maintenance personnel ability evaluation. It's rebuilt from the FCE method. First, the paper designed an evaluation index model. Then the application steps of the fuzzy evaluating method are introduced, combined with an instance.

articleTitle: A reliability method of the behavior modeling of the virtual soldier
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: The combat simulation system requires more high fidelity and reliability. This paper introduces the virtual soldier in a limited sense in order to improve the quality of the modeling and simulation. Based on the virtual soldier, a limited perception of the model framework is built. A virtual model of the soldiers of the limited vision, limited hearing model and the limited memory model are also proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis of fatigue strength of rail axle-steel based on possibility theory
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: When there is limited objective failure data, a method for developing the possibility distribution by subjective assignment strategies is put forward, which is illustrated by the lifetime data from fatigue reliability tests. Based on a limited fatigue life data, a study on reliability analysis of 40 axle-steel is presented, by constructing the possibility distribution function of the locomotive axle steel fatigue life as well as calculating the possibility reliability of fatigue strength at any one time of the axle under a certain stress level.

articleTitle: Evaluation mode of robustness of equipment support system under uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Uncertainty in the battle field is an important factor affecting the decisions of the commanders of operation. Based on the uncertainty of the task and the complexity of the equipment support system, the article adopts the systematic resource capability evaluation mode calculated by grading. In consideration of the uncertainty of task requirement, resource loss and task process, the article adopts corresponding robustness evaluation method and finally testifies the effectiveness of the evaluation mode by living examples.

articleTitle: Economic efficiency of enterprises assessment based on multivariate statistical analysis method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: This paper describes a multivariate statistical analysis technique for enterprises economic efficiency assessment. Using this method to provide a scientific basis for enterprises decision-making is of great significance to improving enterprises economic performance.As the main two methods of multivariate statistical, principal component analysis and cluster analysis methods have been applied in the data statistical analysis involving 15 enterprises. The analysis results have been mutual comparison and validation by using these two methods. After analyzing 7 economic benefit data indicators of the 15 enterprises, the operating conditions, impact factor and solution of these enterprises have been studied.

articleTitle: Application of FMECA and FTA in the fault diagnosis for diesel engine
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Maintainability analysis method combined with FMECA and FTA is proposed for the failure analysis of a type of diesel engine combustion system. Failure modes and cause analysis for this type of diesel engine combustion system are identified, and the hazard is analyzed. Finally, the real failure situation of this diesel engine is presented to validate the analysis results from the proposed method, which can be used to conduct the maintenance activities.

articleTitle: Research on condition based maintenance mode of military power plant
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: In order to reduce the equipment fault and maintenance time, increase the availability and residual life of the important components, the application of condition based maintenance (CBM) technology has become the focus in maintenance field. This paper introduces the application of CBM on fault detect of military power plant equipment, expounds on the research and application actualities of CBM according to military mobile power plant maintenance requirement and technology. On the basis of the analysis of the necessity and feasibility of CBM on fault detect mode, which puts forward the CBM system framework for military power plant, and explains in detail the core modules, the key technologies (state information acquisition and monitoring, testing and diagnosis based on embedded system, data mining and information fusion, fault diagnosis and prediction, and maintenance strategy), presents the CBM system workflow. Finally, it discusses the development of CBM and the research proves that CBM has great application prospect for fault detect of military mobile power plant.

articleTitle: The testing method research for level keeping performance of certain equipment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: The testing method of level keeping performance achieved by reviewing distance change of hydraulic jar piston to ground is elaborated in this paper. Its theoretical basis is discussed, and software and hardware's engineering attainments are introduced. The testing result shows that this method can achieve the automatic and high efficient test of level keeping performance with high precision. Trouble position is defined according to this method.

articleTitle: Research on contractor support delay time
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Equipment contractor support is the innovative practice and urgent requirement to promote new-type equipment forming operational and support capability. The support delay time is a significant discrimination between contractor support and Army support. As concerned breach of contract problem, the paper will take research on three kinds of support delay time: non-repair parts supply delay time, personnel delay time, facility and equipment delay time and breach of contract delay time.

articleTitle: Assessment of the reliability of the solder joints of the ultra-fine-pitch FCBGA
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: In this study, reliability assessment of the IMC layer of the ultra-fine-pitch FC-BGA(Flip-Chip Ball Grid Array) is conducted. The samples are prepared to reveal the differences in the adhesion forces of the IMC layer by dissimilarly establishing each plating thickness for surface finish(Ni/Pd/Au). The hardness and thickness of a P-rich Ni layer, which is known as the weakest section in ENPIG surface, are measured using the nano-indentation and TEM analysis. The degree of adhesion of the IMC layer under each experimental condition is evaluated and the metal plate shear test is performed for verification. The results showed significant correlations between the hardness and thickness of the IMC later and the high fraction defectives of the brittle fractures whose IMC layer had low hardness.

articleTitle: The research on failure issues for a hydraulic system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: The hydraulic systems are widely used in industry, but they would inevitably give rise to some failures. Firstly, this paper describes some hydraulic system failures in a reliability test. Secondly, it makes a detailed analysis for the reasons of failure. Lastly, some corresponding solutions are given for the different failures.

articleTitle: A field study of work demands on railway traffic dispatchers in centralised centres
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the work demands of the dispatchers in centralized centers were investigated. The factors contributing to the work demands were defined preliminarily by specialist workshops and were determined using a series of methods in a field study. The results of our investigation indicate that the total number of trains and frequency of communication are major roles in the total work demands of the dispatchers. Additionally, there are regional distinctions due to the presence of different technologies and network infrastructures.

articleTitle: Study on fault evaluation in Software-intensive equipment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Fault pattern and mechanism of Software-intensive equipment are discussed and thought of application on fault diagnosis in Software-intensive equipment by HMM is presented. Based on the HMM theory, the algorithm of which is modified by multi-state reliability analysis to evaluate the state of Software-intensive equipment fault pattern. The result shows that the method presented can succeed in recognizing fault pattern of Software-intensive equipment and evaluating the state of system.

articleTitle: Study on simulation method of thermal stress and deformation in CCD composite dielectrics
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Focused on the CCD composite dielectrics (Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>), the method of the thermal-mechanical coupling simulation was studied by three different ANSYS models including the whole model, the 1/4 model and the 2-D model in this paper. The thermal stress and deformation were calculated, and the reasonableness of the simulation method was validated, and the differences of these three models simulation results were also discussed. Based on analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of these three models, the adaptability conditions of three models were discussed. This study is useful to investigate the simulation method of thermal stress and deformation in the multi-layer film, especially whose thickness is much thinner than its other dimensions.

articleTitle: Research on the reliability of carbon/epoxy composite based on acoustic emission parameters
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: In order to study the operating life of structural components under the condition of load, the tensile damage experiments of carbon/epoxy composite are done in this paper. Then the mathematic model of the damage development of carbon/epoxy composite is built based on the experimental signal parameters, and then the reliability of carbon/epoxy composite is also discussed in this paper. Finally, the relationship between residual life of composite material and working-ours is deduced.

articleTitle: Statistical sampling inspection in overhaul quality of military equipment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: It introduces statistical sampling inspection (SSI) in overhaul quality inspection of a certain military equipment. The discrimination programs and switching rules of SSI are studied. Then, the practical implementation procedure of SSI is established systemically, and the evaluation method is also discussed. Aiming at a practical instance of overhaul quality inspection, sampling inspection plans are made and evaluated.

articleTitle: Research on RCM-AHP based armored equipment maintenance tactic optimizing
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Contraposing the problem of choosing an optimum maintenance mode for armored equipment important function components, RCM theories and methods are used to evaluate the fault criticality of the important function components and confirm the estimating indexes for the maintenance modes and their weight scales, while AHP method is applied to establishing the hiberarchy of the important function component maintenance decision-making. According to calculating and comparing the resultant weight scales of the maintenance modes for different important function components, the rational maintenance modes are ascertained and some important conclusions are educed, which provides a new thought and method for logical decision-making of good-sized complex equipment maintenance.

articleTitle: Study on direct updating theory for derrick steel structures with damage and defacements
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Several damage and defacements widely existing in derrick steel structures are divided into local and overall damage and defacements. Local damage and defacements include cross-section corrosion, member bar initial flexure and the nodes stiffness reducing. The overall damage defacements include overall initial flexure, loading eccentricity and support subsidence. The corresponding damage correction functions are respectively derived. Revising the finite element model directly by these functions, the numerical model tending to real structure can be obtained. Measurement for damage and defacements and dynamic load stress test are conducted on in-service derrick steel structure. The corrosion thickness of member bars, the initial flexural deformation of the rods, the overall initial flexure, the loading eccentricity and support subsidence are measured. Direct updating theory is used to revise the finite element model, and safety assessment for the in-service derrick steel structure is carried on. The results show that the derrick steel structure with damage and defacements can not meet the original design requirements and the actual bearing capacity decreases. The results provide a valuable reference for the safety operation of the in-service derrick steel structure.

articleTitle: Research and application of virtual instrument for tank integrated simulator based-on LabWindows
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Tank situation display system is a basic component of the tank integrated simulator. This paper describes the design process of virtual instrument for tank integrated simulator based on LabWindows. The hardware architecture and diagrams of system are introduced first. The software module architecture and design development process are given later. The research of several key issues is focused on, such as signal collection, communication in TCP model, control of operation load system as well as parameters tests in automatic condition. And finally practical interface images of tank virtual instruments which give a powerful technical support for detection and maintenance are achieved so that met the demands for training purpose.

articleTitle: A safety risk assessment method considering epistemic uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: In the areas of safety risk assessment, how to consider uncertainty properly becomes a challenge. To resolve this problem, a new system state description method was presented firstly in the DET, that is system state sequence which can record the evolvement process of accident, and then the arithmetic of state sequence probability was designed. The probability of accident can be calculated easily in the DET based on those probabilities. Because the uncertainty of input parameters is ubiquitous in the safety risk assessment model, the QMU (Quantification of Margins and Uncertainty) method was introduced. Using LHS (Latin Hypercube Sample) to research the uncertainty of risk index was adopted, at the same time, the margins and uncertainty of risk index can be obtained which is also the information of safety risk assessment. To demonstrate the performance gains of our model, a cooling liquid tank system was analyzed as an example. The result shows that these methodologies can be used to assess risk more conveniently and credibly. Furthermore, the conclusions can be used to guide the risk control and improve system safety.

articleTitle: Research on the ability-forming process of equipment support based on whole life cycle
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: In order to accelerate equipment forming support ability as soon as possible, this paper analyses the meanings and elements of equipment support ability, and constructs the ability-forming process model of equipment support based on whole life cycle according to support ability requirements phase, support ability planning phase, support ability generation phase, support ability forming and assessment phase. This paper also discusses the technique system of equipment support capability production process during whole life cycle.

articleTitle: Storage-work joint degradation model for discontinuous-working devices
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: For discontinuous-working devices, storage and work states may appear alternately. The health state of the device can be monitored by observing key performance parameters in engineering, which can be also taken as a basis to predict and analyze life and reliability of the device. For this kind of device, this paper comprehensively analyzes performance degradation mechanism in storage and working conditions, and establishes a storage-work joint model for the device, then estimates parameters of the joint degradation model by analyzing performance degradation data with change point characteristic. On this basis, reliability analysis and life prediction will be achieved. In the end of this paper, a joint degradation model of the metalized film capacitor will be established, and the reliability and life of the capacitor will also be calculated and predicted.

articleTitle: Research on grinding dimension of gear-shaving cutter based on Maclaurin series
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Shaving teeth is a common accurate method for cutting gears. The meshing transmission of shaver processing gear is such as a pair of crisscross shaft. Because shaving cutter needs grinding many times on the condition, so that it becomes blunt. How to check and calculate the mesh parameter and these parameters whether meet the choose conditions are important tasks. In addition, these processes are blocking points in manufacture engineering constantly. This paper introduces a rapid look-up table method of calculating parameters based on Maclaurin series and put forward some qualitative conclusions. The experiments results show that the rapidly determine the selected shaving cutter of tooth profile is whether or not within the allowed the workpiece gear-shape error range.

articleTitle: Studies on subjects design in equipment virtual maintenance training system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Firstly, the importance of subjects design in virtual maintenance training system is emphasized, and then the main factors that affect the design for subjects in virtual maintenance training are analyzed. Secondly, the detailed design process of virtual maintenance training subjects is illustrated based on the analysis of training requirements. Finally, this process is applied in the design of a concrete virtual training subject which validated the reasonability and feasibility of the process.

articleTitle: Analysis of incentive strategies of ordnance material supplier direct delivery based on stackelberg model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: The just-in-time (JIT) delivery is the most important aim of ordnance material supplier direct delivery support (SDDS). However, different profit targets determine the leader-follower game relationship between ordnance material support organization and supplier. Therefore, the objective compatible incentive strategy to supplier should be adopted to improve the capability of JIT delivery. On the premise of uncertainty of demand, the optimal incentive strategy to supplier is obtained by the Stackelberg model of ordnance material supplier direct delivery incentive. First, the model analyzes the necessary condition of the existence of optimum delivery time and incentive. Then, the model further interprets the relationship between correlative parameters and optimal solution. In conclusion, the incentive to supplier can improve the capability of JIT delivery, but the different optimum incentive strategies should be carried out by the relative parameters.

articleTitle: Study on dynamical behavior of CRH vehicle based on a new wheel-rail contact model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Base on an improved three-dimensional wheel-rail contact trace algorithm and a new model of wheel-rail contact force, dynamical model of China Railway High-speed(CRH) vehicle is established, which can quick get wheel-rail contact point and contact force and accurately predict vehicle dynamic behavior. Then, a new vehicle dynamic simulation system is developed in MATLAB, called dynamic derailment system for CRH (DDSCRH). Consequently, dynamic behavior of wheelset, bogie and carbody are all calculated in straight line and curve line. Most important, dynamical derailment process of high speed vehicle is obtained by DDSCRH. Results shows there exists the critical position on climb wheel and the critical impact speed on impact derailment is also obtained. The simulation system can be used to study dynamic derailment mechanism and help to find the key factors to the incident.

articleTitle: Integral inference method of incomplete reliability information with reliability growth model under delayed fix mode
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the reliability estimation with incomplete reliability information in different development stages of products, an integral inference method is given in this paper. By using the maximum likelihood method, the log-likelihood function for the type-I censored and grouped data is established. The point estimation of parameters and the covariance between them are also obtained. At last, a lot of Monte Carlo simulation is adopted to prove the method given in this paper is better than the traditional method. Because the method given in this paper can make the reliability data in different stages an integral for statistical analysis, it can reach higher precision than the traditional method.

articleTitle: An improved method of quality evaluation for meteorological radiosonde based on D-S theory
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the deficiencies of the present methods, this paper proposes an improved method based on the comprehensive application of D-S theory and fuzzy method. We divide Interpretative Structural Modeling (ISM) system which is established according to the characteristics of key factors and related indexes of radiosonde in early evaluation course into two major parts. I.e. `many-to-one' structure and `one-to-many' structure, and discuss how to analyze the two structures. Finally, we verify the feasibility and veracity of this method through the specific testing of GZZ11 radiosonde quality.

articleTitle: An extensive IP reliability evaluation platform
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: The reliability and robustness of Intellectual Properties (IPs) are the keys to the success of the modern System on Chip (SoC) designs. Therefore, it is very important to implement a rigid IP evaluation platform to ensure the reliability of IPs in the SoC design flow. In this paper, we introduce major aspects of IP reliability and present a XML schema based metric model which is able to describe reliability characteristics of IP cores. An evaluation platform is implemented based on the metric model. The experimental results on three open source IPs demonstrate that the evaluation platform can assess IP reliability quantitatively and locate its bottleneck.

articleTitle: The virtual training system of armored vehicle
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: In this thesis, a new virtual training system based on the virtual reality technology the form of desktop and the stimulation technology is introduced. It is able to satisfy the needs of the armored forces. By using the system, the teaching of the equipments, the virtual maintenance, the professional virtual training and the virtual tactical coordinated attack can be performed which are based on the actual conditions of the armored vehicles.

articleTitle: Design of Equipment Health Management system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Equipment health management is not only a technology method, this paper gives two systems of organization and technology in order to combining the technology and management system availably. It builds equipment health management organization system with three levels of of decision-making, planning management and executive level and also gives the main technology works of data processing, condition monitoring, condition evaluating, condition forecasting and decision supporting. It gives a new angle of view in studying Equipment Health Management.

articleTitle: Research on strengthening the construction of equipment contractor support
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the problem that military equipment support resources cannot usually meet the demand, the conception and significance of equipment contractor support are clarified, and the state of art of the equipment contractor support is analyzed in such six aspects as ideology and conception, theoretical research, policy and law, support resources, market environment, and management competence. Furthermore, the countermeasures of the construction of equipment contractor support are put forward. We provide some references for the implementation of the equipment contractor support, which correspondingly enhances the support competence and battle effectiveness.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of a satellite system considering common cause failures
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: According to the necessity of reliability analysis for satellite system subjected to common-cause failures, the unreliability expression under a variety of common-cause condition is developed to analyze the unreliability of satellite system in this paper. Based on static fault tree analysis of satellite system, the binary decision diagram is used to evaluate the reliability considering common-cause failures. The importance of prevention of common-cause failures in large structured redundancy system is verified by using practical calculation example.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of certain artillery servo system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: According to the working principle of certain artillery servo system, various component parts of artillery servo system are modeled using graphical modeling methods with MATLAB/ Simulink, and on this basis the general dynamic model of artillery servo system is established and simulated in the paper. The result shows that the model established can meet the characteristic requirements of the actual system, which provides a modeling method and theoretical foundation for the character analysis of artillery servo system.

articleTitle: The study of four kinds of quality theory for equipment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: This paper puts forward four kinds of quality of equipment, and defines the concept, and analyses the logical relationship between the four kinds of quality, and expound the use of the four kinds of quality in theory. We give a quantitative description of the threshold and the logical expression of the four kinds of quality of the equipment. A mathematical model of the process quality of equipment and the state quality has been constructed and so is the multidimensional variable model of the state quality of the equipment.

articleTitle: Inventory decision model of unanimous ordering policy with multi-item maintenance materials
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: An inventory decision model of multi-item maintenance materials is analyzed for a joint ordering problem. A unanimous ordering policy which reviews inventory continuously of multi-item is applied in the model. The aim of inventory control of maintenance materials is ensuring the service level and reducing the inventory cost. According to this objective, an algorithm is proposed. Firstly, supposed that ordering level and lead time are both zero, and then determine the order-up-to level according to the inventory cost. After that, ordering level of all kinds of maintenance materials is computed according to the fill rate. Finally, an example is given to demonstrate the validity of the model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Application of evolution of singular values in multisymptom diagnostics of machines
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: The paper presents a possibility of observation of singular values evolving in time as quantities carrying diagnostic information. To prove the usefulness of singular values for this purpose many numerical simulations have been conducted. It has been proved that when observing changes of singular values obtained from SVD during the lifetime of a machine, the appearance of reversal points must be taken into account. The appearance of such points may prove that the symptom values change abruptly (e.g. structure cracking). The appearance of such an abrupt change can easily be overlooked because of variable working parameters of the machine, which influence the values of measured symptoms and generalized symptoms after SVD. Singular values are almost insensitive to changes of working parameters, so it is easier to pick out such changes in their evolution than directly in symptoms. The paper also presents an example of application of the proposed method for real diagnostic data obtained from ball bearings.

articleTitle: Modeling and algorithm to mission reliability allocation of spaceflight TT&C system based on radial basis function neural network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: To study mission reliability allocation of the tracking, telemetry and command (TT&C) system, which is difficult to describe with a precise mathematical model and time-consumed to compute, a radial basis function neural network (RBFNN) modeling method with adaptive hybrid learning algorithm (AHL) is proposed. Principal component analysis (PCA) is used to determine the initial number of hidden units. Advanced gradient learning algorithm (AGL) to compute gradient information of network parameters is improved to accelerate convergence. Finally, realization details are provided, and simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The quality evaluation and prediction methods of China's aerospace shooting range equipment's state
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the quality characteristics of aerospace shooting range equipment's state, as well as the condition of quality evaluation and prediction of aerospace shooting range equipment's state; propose the basic principles of quality evaluation and prediction of aerospace shooting range equipment's state: “The simpler the better”, “The more comprehensive the better”, “The more quantified, the better”, “The more the scene the better”; give the basic ideas and processes ideas of quality evaluation and prediction of aerospace shooting range equipment's state.

articleTitle: Research on mission equipment configuration proportion for small scale cargo transport fleet
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Cargo transport can perform many type missions, such as airlift, airdrop and airborne etc. Each type mission need corresponding cargo configuration by installing mission equipment in the cargo to meet the need of the mission. The configuration proportions of mission equipments must consider the mission capability rate, economy and utilization ratio. The paper take small scale cargo transport fleet as the object, set up a mathematical model based on the optimization principle and boundary conditions, use the linear weighted sum approach to solve the question, give a sensitivity analysis and bias analysis, finally get the best configuration proportion of every mission equipment. This method can solve the mission equipment configuration problem for small scale cargo transport fleet.

articleTitle: Research on civil-military integrated weapon materiel support mechanism
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Through integrated analysis to the weapon material support elements of information flow, material flow, personnel flow and capital flow, this paper formed the civil-military integrated weapon material support system based on network and information. Civil-military integrated weapon material support operation mechanism is established through the aspects of management operation, support mobilization, quality supervision, market competition, regulations and standards and safety insurance, which provide powerful motive force and reliable guarantee for the improvement of civil-military integrated weapon material support.

articleTitle: Bi-variant LFP method for Rayleigh distributed TSDS analysis of aeroengine combustion cylinder
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: In this research, a stress-strength interference model is developed based on bi-variant Lagrange factor polynomial approach. The first discrete random variable is the independent stress. Thermal stress-dependent strength is represented by the second discrete random variable that has different conditional probability mean functions depending on different stress amplitudes. Then the approach is used to generate the bi-variant stress-strength interference model. In this model the thermal strength probability mean function is Rayleigh distributed, while the thermal stress probability mean function is Normal distributed. Accuracy of this method is investigated by specific aeroengine combustion cylinder.

articleTitle: Running safety trait analysis of tracked vehicle transiting unilateral obstruction
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Based on the accident that the tracked vehicle rolls over when rapidly passing the unilateral obstruction, this paper analyzes the system using the system-theory and the kinetic methods on the safety trait of the process that the tracked vehicle pass rapidly through the unilateral-obstruction. The state equation of running trait that the rapid tracked vehicle shows in the passing of unilateral-obstruction is established, as well as the mathematical expression analyzing the process. Using the calculating tools, the analysis and calculation of the numerical values from each process, the parameters of different training roads and different muzzle velocity is completed, and the correlative figures are also protracted. The results indicate that if the parameters of training road change, the critical numerical values differs. That is to say, bifurcation point and mutation point are different respectively. The analysis not only provides the theory foundation for preventing the accident of passing obstruction by one side of tracked armored vehicle, but also is of high practical value.

articleTitle: Method to analyze the influence degree of service processes based on wavelet neural network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: In order to analyze the influence degree between after-sales service quality and usage quality of aviation equipment, a method based on wavelet neural network (WNN) is proposed that support the equipment supplier to determine the key workflow and factors. Supplier workflow index-equipment usage quality relation function was established, and the overall effectiveness was defined. MATLAB was used for approximation of the relation function, and effectiveness, timeliness and stability of workflow were regarded as the analysis indexes. An equipment supplier workflow was given as a specific application.

articleTitle: Research on development of equipment health management
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: The maintenance is recognized deeply and deeply along with flourish development of equipment maintenance theory and technology, people attach more and more importance to the new management mode and means of equipment maintenance-Health Management theory. The research of health management is important, and analysing the formation and development of health management is not only the precondition of research, but also the foundation. In this paper, first of all, the development course of foreign equipment health management is reviewed; then the research status of domestic equipment health management is analyzed from theory research and application aspects; in the end, main problems and development trends of equipment health management research are pointed out.

articleTitle: The equipment supportability risk identification and analysis method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Considering the problems in the aspects of equipment supportability, this paper has suggested the method and model of supportability risk assessment, especially has given out a practical and useful method on the supportability risk assessment. This method concludes the identification of supportability risk area, building up the rules in supportability risk estimation, the measurements of supportability risk, the evaluation of supportability risk etc. It has provided efficient ways for supportability risk management, so as to greatly support the level up of readiness and combat ability for equipment.

articleTitle: The reliable and cost-effective test solution for military computer devices with PCI, ISA and MULTIBUS I bus based on StarFabric technique
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: PCI, ISA and MULTIBUS I bus are the mainstream military computer peripheral device buses in defense electrical equipments. Realizing functional testing of devices with these buses has significant impacts on maintenance. This paper analyzes the bus test requirements, discusses the advantages and disadvantages of several general test approaches. Then the reliable solution is suggested based on StarFabric® technique, it lowers acquirement cost and reduces development load. The prototype is established and key technique is verified. The approach can be applied in the maintenance testing.

articleTitle: Parameter optimization of harmonic gear drive based on hybrid genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Addressing problems of larger volume of harmonic gear in the conventional design, in this paper, a mathematical model of optimization with hybrid discrete variables is proposed by taking the modulus of harmonic gear transmission parameters m, the length of flexspline L, wall thickness δ and tooth width of flexspline b as design variables, and the sum of volume of circular spline and flexspline as an objective function to be minimized. During the procedure of optimization, the basic idea of the hybrid genetic algorithm is constructed, and the basic procedure of the hybrid genetic algorithm is compiled. The hybrid genetic algorithm used in the parameter optimization of harmonic gear drive is testified to be effective, and optimization results can meet the design standard. Therefore, the proposed method will be of the significant guiding value to engineering practices.

articleTitle: The research on test and evaluation method for maintainability of the shrapnel emitter
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a method based on Bayes theory is presented aiming at the problems of small sample maintainability verification for the shrapnel emitter. And Posterior Probability Ratio Test of maintainability index verification in the logarithmic normal distribution is discussed in detail. By analyzing the test data of the shrapnel emitter, it is proved that the method is effective and reasonable to reduce the sample size and test cost.

articleTitle: Analysis of equipment maintenance quality on the point of organization and management
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: With application of the “great quality” thought in modern management, the paper analyzes affecting factors of equipment maintenance quality in detail on the view of organization and management. Firstly, according to single batch of work flow and main work contents on organization level, this paper analyzes and defines the main affecting factors of equipment maintenance quality with causality diagram analysis, and builds quality factors system. Then it analyzes the main affecting points of every factor and builds affecting relation structure of every factor and the contents of those relations. Finally, this work defines the key affecting factors with Plato-figure analysis, providing the basis for later process control to equipment maintenance quality.

articleTitle: Research on the mechanism of contractor support for new-type equipment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: One of the current trends in most armies of the world is to reduce the size of the military, but this may cause serious problems in manpower for equipment support. To resolve this problem, the best way is to make use of non-military resources in the form of contractor support. This paper discusses the necessity and feasibility of using contractor support for new-type equipment based on the requirements for adapting the Chinese military to high-tech war, the requirements for achieving transformation in military affairs and the requirements for civil-military integration in equipment support.

articleTitle: Fuzzy fault tree analysis of mask stage
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: Fault tree analysis (FTA) is a top-down approach for failure analysis, starting with a potential undesirable event called a TOP event, and then determining all the ways it can happen. FTA is the most commonly used technique for causal analysis in risk and reliability studies. Mask stage an important part of lithography. In this paper, Fault Tree of the mask stage is built with “Mask stage doesn't work” as the top event. Quantitative assessment and qualitative analysis based on Fuzzy Logic are carried out. And the importance of bottom events is calculated.

articleTitle: Interaction prediction optimization in multidisciplinary design environment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
abstract: The increasing complexity of engineering systems has sparked rising interests in multidisciplinary design optimization (MDO). However, the main challenges in MDO are its computational expense and complexity structure. Therefore, to address these challenges, this paper focuses on a new MDO method, interaction prediction optimization approach, which is a design architecture applied in the multidisciplinary environment. In this approach, a complex system is decomposed hierarchically along disciplinary boundaries into a number of subsystems, which are taken multidisciplinary agreement into account by a system-level coordination process. A mathematical problem and an engineering design problem are presented to highlight the potential application of the new method in multidisciplinary design optimization.

articleTitle: Dynamic finite-element simulation on the phased array radar antenna multiplex damage by fragment and shock wave
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Quality, Reliability, Risk, Maintenance, and Safety Engineering
